categories.title: Repairs, troubleshooting and emergencies
categories.intro: Something has stopped working, tripped, buzzed or smelled hot. Diagnosis comes before any replacement.

items.name: Emergency electrician
items.line: Power out to part of a unit, a burning smell, a sparking outlet or a panel that's hot to the touch. Safe a hazard first, then repair.

items.name: Power outage electrician
items.line: Half the unit dark while the building has power usually means a lost phase, a failed breaker or a loose feeder termination.

items.name: Burning smell from an outlet
items.line: Turn the circuit off at the breaker and call. Heat at a device is a loose connection or an overloaded circuit, not a nuisance.

items.name: Electrical repair services
items.line: Dead outlets, flickering lights and intermittent faults, found and fixed with the cause written down.

items.name: Electrical troubleshooting
items.line: Methodical fault-finding for problems that come and go, the kind that need testing rather than guessing.

items.name: Circuit breaker repair and replacement
items.line: A breaker that keeps tripping is reporting a fault. We find the fault before swapping the breaker.

items.name: GFCI outlet not working
items.line: A GFCI that won't reset, or trips with nothing plugged in, often points to moisture or a shared downstream circuit.

items.name: Electrical wiring repair
items.line: Damaged, overheated or amateur wiring found behind fixtures and in junction boxes during renovation.
